apps.name: Herd Journal
apps.tagline: Dungeon and raid journal for the Herd MoP server
apps.description: Every dungeon, raid and world boss from Classic to Mists of Pandaria: boss abilities with the real numbers for your difficulty, tank / healer / DPS tips, and loot tables with class and slot filters. Search, favorites, and it works offline.

apps.name: Herd Wardrobe
apps.tagline: Herd's custom looks in 3D on your characters
apps.description: Browse every custom look on the Herd server - the monk tier sets in every difficulty and the Herd imports - see them in 3D on your own characters, and track which pieces you have collected.

apps.name: Pandaria Codex
apps.tagline: The lore of Mists of Pandaria
apps.description: A lore encyclopedia for Mists of Pandaria: the zones, peoples, factions and heroes, the August Celestials and the Sha, and the history of the pandaren empire - 92 entries from the Warcraft Wiki. Foldable reading layout, search, and a look built from the game's own mogu-gold art. The lore reads offline.

apps.name: Herd Launcher
apps.tagline: A home screen made for the Fold 8 Ultra
apps.description: Separate layouts for the cover and inner screens that switch the moment you fold, plus a tabletop mode when half-folded. Swipe gestures for the drawer, notifications and quick settings, double-tap to lock, and one search box for apps, app shortcuts, contacts, settings, sums and the web. Colours follow your wallpaper.
